explanation: The Banking Ombudsman is a senior official appointed by the Reserve Bank of India to redress customer complaints against deficiency in certain banking services.
RBI issues currency, regulates the financial system, and manages foreign exchange. Personal income tax rates are determined by the Central Government/Ministry of Finance.
An MICR code consists of 9 digits (first 3 represent city, next 3 represent bank, last 3 represent branch).
